The simple save box and calm card layout feel right, and newest-first is a good default. I’d eventually like to choose a different order, but that doesn’t need to complicate this screen.

For the useful details, I want the page title, short description, actual site icon, a preview image when the page provides one, and the date I saved it. I should be able to adjust the title and description before confirming the save, as well as edit them later, because automatically gathered details are not always helpful.

There are two save conditions I’d want handled before we lock this down:

- If I enter something that isn’t a usable web address, tell me rather than saving a broken item. An address such as `nytimes.com` can be accepted, but it must still open the correct website afterward.
- If I save a link that is already in my library, don’t create a duplicate. Take me to the existing entry so I can edit it instead.
